run_dlrm_training: run the DLRM PyTorch training script with argparse flags for model architecture, data, and GPU settings
run_dlrm_inference: run the DLRM model in inference-only mode with optional INT4/INT8 quantization for embeddings and MLPs
run_dlrm_distributed: run the DLRM model in distributed mode across multiple GPUs using the extend_distributed backend
build_dlrm_model: build a DLRM_Net model with configurable bottom/top MLP layers, embedding tables, and dot or cat interaction operators
export_dlrm_onnx: export the trained DLRM PyTorch model to ONNX format with dynamic batch size axes
